annotations.text: Faces at 2x (240 px; the engine draws them at 120). Static energy face, ranged kinetic face with crit, shield face, cracked face. The four fixed positions are the rule to keep or break.

Three treatments of the same 20 to 50 kinetic face with 15% crit. A puts the ceiling big and the floor small. B shows the range with a spread bar whose tick is the floor a passive can raise. C is the vector HUD register. Fourth is the locked state.
